cases.name: an entry spawnChild of a promise adds the child
cases.test: spawnChild.test.ts > spawnChild action > can spawn (the promise is a host actor)

cases.name: an entry spawnChild of a named actor adds the child with its input
cases.test: spawnChild.test.ts > spawnChild action > can spawn from named actor (the promise is a host actor, named by the case's actors where the test gives it with machine.provide)

cases.name: an entry spawnChild whose id is computed from the context names the child a later sendTo reaches
cases.test: spawnChild.test.ts > spawnChild action > should handle a dynamic id (the spy is the child's assign counting FOO in its context)

excluded.test: spawnChild.test.ts > spawnChild action > should accept `syncSnapshot` option
